notes.title: Purchase Bonus: New Settlers & Future Plans
notes.content:
ver.2.3


- Purchase Bonus: New Settlers -
I created a game of luck called 99,999 Ryo.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3501960/99999/

As a special bonus, buyers will receive an additional settler:

Black Ninja

This is a simple mini-game where you continuously make the right choice in a two-option game to reach the goal.
It was created as a project to learn about online systems, so the game itself is extremely simple.
It's a tough challenge, so only certain players will find it enjoyable.

Currently, I am working on a game that is not an original title, so there will be no new settlers for a while.



- Future Update Plans -
The concept for the next update is taking shape.
Although it's still tentative, here are some planned updates:

Fishing Feature
This is a completely idle feature.
Instead of engaging in frontier development, players can simply fish.
Depending on what is caught, a high-tension boost may occur, or the material acquisition rate may temporarily increase.

Favorite Character Feature
Players will be able to select one favorite character at the base camp.
The selected favorite character will always depart at the front.

Additional Building Blueprints
Rather than simple additions, this will feel like progressing into a second round of construction.
The required development power will increase compared to the first round.

Various Minor Fixes

Display improvements when returning after failing to defeat a monster
Showing the highest reached distance at base camp
Adjustments to some daily quest conditions
That's all for now.
In the future, I plan to introduce more systems that increase material collection rates.

Initially, I intended fishing to be available for all characters, but now it seems only specific members will be able to fish.
Why? Because I thought:
"Since there are so many settlers, wouldn't it be fun if each had unique actions?"

If you've unlocked the maximum number of settlers, you may have noticed that some characters are grouped by outfit themes.
I’m considering adding special group-based actions that increase specific rewards.

Now that I’ve thought of it, there's no turning back. This will be a thorny path.
But as long as I don’t lose motivation, it will be implemented properly.
Since I’m handling multiple projects alone, please be patient.

Finally, please leave a Steam review to boost my motivation!
Whether you enjoyed the game, disliked it, or just want me to update faster—anything is fine!
I’d love to hear your feedback.

notes.title: ver2.0 Update Information
notes.content:
ver2.0
Version updated.

Fever time behavior has been changed.
Previously, everyone had a constant speed, but now it has been changed to current speed +30.
Additionally, click boost is now applied.

Monster specifications have been changed.
Monsters are now placed every 10km.
If not defeated within 60 seconds, you will be sent back 9km.
If sent back, the value of the "Total Distance Pioneered" achievement will not increase until the boss is defeated.
In the monster area, three monsters are placed.
As a result, the required amounts for the "Total Monsters Defeated" and "Weekly 3" achievements have been increased.

Added facility enhancement items.
Facility skills can now be enhanced when specific blueprints are obtained at the base camp.
Enhancements require Pioneering Power and Coins.

Horse Stable Skill "Fast Horse" in Facility Enhancements
When a monster is defeated, there is a chance to skip 10% of the "Highest Reached Distance."
As the level increases, the activation rate improves.
The skill activates up to 90% of the "Highest Reached Distance."

Added Achievement "Fairy Touch"
Counts when you touch a fairy.
The reward increases the amount of time gained during fever time when clicking fairies after completing daily quests by 1 second.
Base value: 10 seconds + Lv.

Added Achievement "Weekly Quest Complete"
Counts when all weekly quests are cleared, and you return to the base.
Increases pioneering power gained from clicks.
Pioneering power gained from clicks × (Lv+1).
Counting starts after the version update.

Other Changes and Fixes
The calculation methods for Mining Power, Logging Power, Material HP, and Monster HP have been changed. As a result, the numbers are now 100 times higher than before.
Click boost is now applied to attack power (Logging Power + Mining Power) against enemies.
Stamina consumption now only decreases when gathering or attacking.
The achievement for "Total Distance Pioneered" was locked at Lv31, but now it has no limit.
The calculation for character level-up multipliers (10x and 100x) was not functioning properly, so it has been temporarily removed.
Achievement information alignment has been shifted to the left. However, some descriptions are still truncated depending on the language.

About ver2.0
With the facility skill "Swift Horse" and the adjustment of Fever Time speed, it should now be easier to return to the highest reached point after going back to the base.
Facility upgrades at the base camp significantly increase the amount of wood and stone acquired, so the difficulty of leveling up despite having blueprints should be somewhat alleviated.
There may still be balance issues, so any comments or feedback would be appreciated.


Emoji Face Jump! Now Available
We have released a new game, "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2638350/Emoji_Face_Jump/]Emoji Face Jump![/url]"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206385/5334efb299d1039e93fc6f3fcb6cea42cbecabd1.jpg[/img]
If you purchase this game, one new explorer will join your base camp.
However, this game is quite frustrating, so if you don't want to get annoyed, it might be better to buy it without playing.

notes.title: ver1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45206385/a43aab9df3e6f9b069dab24594f10a4e25271d51.jpg[/img]

ver1.1
Updated version. The changes are as follows.


When a tree and a stone can be destroyed with a single blow, the player can now run through them without stopping.
When a player is boosted by high tension, he/she can run through without stopping.
The HP bar of the enemy is displayed.
The version is indicated in the upper right corner of the credits.
Fixed a problem where the mining power was not working properly.





<Future Plans>
Sorry for the imbalance in many ways.
I have received a few pointers and will correct them as I go along.


<There is no need to return to base camp>

The need to return to base camp has diminished because you can go anywhere if you take your time.
Therefore, I would like to change the specification of monsters.

Place a monster every 10 km.
If the monster cannot be defeated within 30 seconds, it will be sent back some kilometers.

I plan to adjust the current specifications because the HP of the monsters is too low.
I plan to adjust logging and mining power accordingly.



<Once back at base camp, it takes a while to get back to the same point again>

We are planning to add a special ability to skip 1-2% of the highest point with a probability after defeating a monster.
We are considering a mechanism to return to the highest point as quickly as possible.


I hope to have a good flow of reinforcement, returning and reinforcing when enemies appear that cannot be defeated.
